title: Tracker connections
description: How a hub reaches an issue tracker, and what each harness fact does there. One object at the root. Optional: a hub with no `docs/estate/trackers.json` has no tracker, and nothing else changes. Holds no credential, only the names of the environment variables a developer's own credential is read from. Written by `/connect-jira`, never by hand. Read by `check-trackers.mjs` and `jira-sync.mjs`. `check-trackers.mjs` is stricter than this schema where JSON Schema cannot say it: a defect needs `parent: "story"` and a story mapping, a story has no parent, `user_env` and `token_env` differ, a route walks only statuses its board lists an id for, a create-field default never names a secret, and `default_board`, `instance` and the like must be own keys of what they name.

instances.description: Keyed by instance id, which a link file's `ticket` field carries so a later move to another site does not orphan it.

site.description: A bare host name such as `example.atlassian.net`. No scheme, path, port, address, user name or token.

base_url.description: Only where a scoped token needs the `api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/<cloudId>` form, and always for `oauth`. Default `https://<site>`. Its host must be this instance's site or api.atlassian.com, with no `..`, no `//` and no trailing `/`. For `oauth` it is exactly `https://api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/<cloudId>`, with the site's cloud id.

auth.description: `api-token`: an Atlassian API token, sent as HTTP basic with the account in `user_env`. `oauth`: an OAuth 2.0 access token, sent as a bearer header, with no `user_env` because the token says who it is.

sprint.description: `report` says whether a ticket is in the board's active sprint; `add` puts it there. Opt-in.

epics.description: No Epic key is stored here: `ask` has `/decompose` ask which Epic per decomposition.

status_ids.description: Status name to status id, so a renamed status is noticed.

parent.description: A sub-task type: created under the story's ticket.

route.description: The ordered statuses from where the move may start to its target.
